primary_claims: Only a qualification hypothesis: deterministic masking may expose source-binding observations beyond original-path gaps; no added information or performance is established.
For fixed source, masked frame and role, blind request bytes are identical when only a masked slot value changes. This does not establish upstream proposal independence or semantic nonleakage.
not_claimed: Neither module nor standard QAG/PAL is claimed novel.
No guarantee of all-task AUROC>=0.8, no new detector result, no semantic relation oracle.
No ordinary prefix-reset, repair-mixture or grammar sweep is proposed as a new observation.

references.relevance: Early false commitments can bias later justifications; this is a hypothesis to test within the new observer, not proof about original generators.

references.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
references.relevance: Independent verification is established prior art; source-only blind verification must be compared against direct verification.

references.relevance: Attention context/history features and trained classifiers are prior art, not a new observation or semantic oracle.

candidates.name: Source-cited executable checks, partial scope
candidates.new_information: Explicit source-cell provenance, typed displayed-value arithmetic and Boolean constraints beyond cached token gaps. Automatic natural-language proposal requires a new frozen-LM observation; the CPU-only part is conditional execution.
input_contract: Full unhighlighted source and original response; original question only if actually preserved.
Automatically propose all eligible obligations, source character/cell references, entity/measure/time/unit keys and a restricted AST; never pass gold spans or manually selected wrong values.
Mask claimed output/direction before asking for the source-derived program/result; retain the original value only in a separately sealed comparison object.
Missing original question, comparison roles, unit, source key, unique interpretation or precise rounding semantics -> unknown.
candidates.conditional_theory: If source leaves are correctly bound, claim roles are correct, operations are sound and units/precision compatible, induction over the restricted expression DAG proves the displayed-value relation. Execution alone does not prove the natural-language parse or account binding.
candidates.cheap_cpu_pilot: Not selected: manually authored fixed-case programs test only an existing conditional executor, not an automatic method or a new pilot.
candidates.decisive_new_intervention: For automatic proposal, withhold the claimed result from the program-producing LM; compare source-cited role-correct programs against equal-valued wrong-account/wrong-year programs. Same numeric answer must not be accepted when lineage/role binding differs.
candidates.not_novel: Program execution is FinQA/PAL prior art; the previous proof/revision kernel is also prior project work. Any new contribution needs evidence that automatic provenance/role proposal now works and adds information.
candidates.feasibility: CPU control feasible from restored inference sources and cached identities; no model is needed for conditional executor tests. Natural coverage is unknown until new LM proposal is admitted and measured.

candidates.name: Deterministic target-masked source reconstruction
candidates.new_information: Hypothesis only: new source-grounded observations of a masked role, compared with direct and deliberately leaky controls; no information gain is yet demonstrated.
input_contract: The sole proposer case input is the complete unhighlighted response; no source, gold, selected error positions or wrong values. It proposes all claim frames and typed slots only; generated questions are rejected.

Default exact claim text is aligned only when unique within the whole response; slot text only when unique within its validated claim. Optional offsets must be paired and strictly exact, with no fallback. Repeated offset-free text is invalid; alignment origin is retained.

Blind payload contains only source, deterministic masked_claim and role. The selected literal slot, repeated literals and declared aliases are masked; no generated question, original full answer, value, aliases or offsets are sent. Source is never censored.
Direct sees the same whole claim plus role and automatic focus span. Leaky uses the identical blind payload and adds claimed_value intentionally.
Output and source quote validation establish literal occurrence only. Unknown is retained for missing premises, alias ambiguity, unbound comparison roles and arithmetic requiring an executor.
theory_assumptions: Source answerability and the semantic frame are recoverable by the frozen model.
Removing the asserted target can reduce observer false-premise anchoring; this is an empirical hypothesis, not a theorem or proof about original generator snowballing.

The blind observation Z must contain conditional information beyond cached G; deterministic postprocessing f(G) alone cannot add information (data-processing inequality). Neither information gain nor a conditional proof guarantees AUROC improvement.
candidates.decisive_new_intervention: Compare target-blind versus value-leaky/source-conditioned questions using the same model and source, plus same-wordbag actor/year/predicate swaps. The predicted bound role must change when source binding changes while vocabulary stays fixed. This is not local unit reset and not a repair-support candidate-future mixture.
candidates.strong_baseline: Common frozen model and automatic frames, direct source-plus-whole-claim verification. Identical 256 output caps do not guarantee equal total compute; report actual prefill/decode/calls/time. No new-method claim if blind adds no reliable information.
candidates.not_novel: QAGS/QAFactEval/CoVe/RefChecker already establish related QA/claim verification. A new name, prompt or slot format alone is not a contribution.
candidates.feasibility: New model inference is required; current cache lacks source-only semantic answers and programs. Resource admission must precede model calls; do not mutate the CPU .venv or terminate other apps.

case_expectations.A_expected: Unknown for the categorical account claim unless an automatic source/claim binding is independently validated; no arithmetic-only clean certificate.
case_expectations.B_expected: Recover Deferred tax assets and Deferred tax liabilities; conflict localized to first account, not the correct second account.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Correct first account; same-wordbag row/actor ownership swap; unrelated table section -> unknown.

case_expectations.A_expected: Unknown: numeric execution does not establish the coverage-period relation.
case_expectations.B_expected: Recover billing frequency=annually and coverage period=annual separately; flag monthly only.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Correct annual coverage; independently change billing frequency; absent coverage statement -> unknown.

case_expectations.A_expected: 17290 arithmetic may be valid, but whole account claim cannot be certified by the result; preserve account-binding unknown.
case_expectations.B_expected: Recover unrecognized tax benefits/gross liability as the account; detect both words of the wrong account phrase if slot extraction succeeds.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Same numbers, correct account; same result with a wrong row/program lineage must not pass.

case_expectations.A_expected: Under unique explicit source binding, displayed difference is +94; numerical result 8 conflicts. Missing comparison role -> unknown, never invent a year pair.
case_expectations.B_expected: Recover the net-revenue comparison if the full response identifies it; distinguish amount from direction; do not assume unmarked decrease is semantically clean.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Increase of94; reverse-year comparison with an explicit reversed question; missing question/ambiguous pair -> unknown.

case_expectations.A_expected: Support displayed-value arithmetic and USDm equivalence when source keys/units bind; never infer that every surrounding clause is clean.
case_expectations.B_expected: Preserve the supported derivation, or call A; absence of literal80.8 in the table is not contradiction.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Wrong signed subtraction; incompatible unit; correct result attached to wrong measure remains unknown/conflict, not support.

case_expectations.A_expected: Unknown without an automatically verified relational binding.
case_expectations.B_expected: Bind two-thirds completion to first robot and all11points to second; conflict on the wrongly assigned completion.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Correct ownership; same-wordbag actor swap must change the bound answer; unresolved pronoun -> unknown.

case_expectations.A_expected: Unknown if reference time/era conversion is underidentified.
case_expectations.B_expected: Recover the source BCE/BC time reference; do not silently convert relative years ago without a known reference date.
case_expectations.negative_controls: Exact source BC wording; missing relative-time anchor -> unknown; unrelated date distractor must not determine the answer.

case_expectations.A_expected: Unknown for boilerplate; no automatic error from source-word absence.

observability_qualification.intervention: Add exactly one leading ASCII space; remove exactly one only when original begins ASCII space. Character-count +/-1 interior controls use eligible existing ASCII gaps; no Unicode lstrip. All unavailable controls remain identity arms with reasons and explicit empty removals.
observability_qualification.limitation: Character order identity does not prove semantic equivalence in code/tables/quotations or any model/interface causal effect. Actual fixed-tokenizer/runtime observation is still required.
